scenario: Unlabelled companion-slot access on a single-line series works per LSER.6.8.2 — when only one observation line covers an aggregation, the unqualified `s.mean` form resolves without label disambiguation. Pin: `series Sensor.state (by: entity_id): mean sliding 10_min` then `where s.mean > 5.0` compiles, so the unqualified form resolves. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope ttl 1_min:
    entity_id: String
    state: Float

series Sensor.state (by: entity_id):
    mean sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.mean > 5.0
->
    log info "high mean"
